correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact three/four-edge silhouette perimeter formulas from tetrahedral edge projection, proved the sharp global minimum separately by a concavity chord in the triangular region and strict concavity in squared coordinates in the quadrilateral region. Obtained a uniform first-order tangent gauge, computed its exact angular sector areas and applied uniform local scaling/dominated convergence for all 12 isolated minima. The standalone checker independently compared 2,000 direct planar convex hull perimeters and checked 6,199 diagnostics; finite tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: The perimeter of a random shadow is a classical natural geometric statistic, distinct from shadow area. Identifying its sharp rare lower tail and the 21.18-percent triangular fraction reveals a genuine asymmetry of local silhouette geometry that is invisible in the earlier equal-split area tail. The marked tangent limit makes the coefficient structural and reusable in stereological sampling and rare-orientation inference.
